summary: Carry the Cart display/readiness fixes onto the latest specialist source and fail closed unless current Matrix/AUX status is explicitly confirmed; keep OTA installability separate from operational readiness.

scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Cart Owner PWA local preflight and the two already validated ace-display fixes, integrated on specialist source 8eaa9255a92f88b2a8ec6f443a38e1acb67df9f6.
scoped_evidence.observed_source_defect: The readiness helper returned READY for an empty array, and its caller inferred device state from visible labels rather than a bounded, current, confirmed status snapshot. The preflight also counted signed OTA installability as runtime readiness. The review candidate now requires named checks, revision-matched confirmed Matrix and AUX reports observed within 90 seconds, and reports score freshness as degraded when the source exposes no timestamp. OTA admission remains in its existing dedicated workflow.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert candidate commits 1902d23 and 21b3c49 or return to specialist source commit 8eaa9255a92f88b2a8ec6f443a38e1acb67df9f6; no deployed runtime was changed.
